title: A sealed machine report (fabric-machine-report/1, DEC-0132)
description: The payload member of a fabric-relay-message/1 body a machine sends to its estate's hub machine. HPKE (RFC 9180) base mode, suite [16, 1, 1], to the hub machine's #kem key; info the ASCII bytes fabric-machine-report/1; additional data the RFC 8785 bytes of {type, from, to, msgId, kem}, from, to and msgId being the enclosing body's signed members. The plaintext is the RFC 8785 bytes, at most 65536, of a machine-report/1 document. The relay reads none of it. docs/specification/relay.md#the-machines-report.

kem.description: The hub machine's key-agreement key id.

enc.description: The encapsulated key: an uncompressed P-256 point (65 bytes), base64url.

ct.description: Ciphertext and tag, base64url: at most 65536 + 16 bytes.
